Container.Name: PersonalFinanceApp
Container.Overview: Personal finance tracker — import bank PDF statements, categorise transactions, track shared expenses.
Container.Description: Personal finance app built with Rust/Axum. Import PDF bank statements, categorise transactions and track shared expenses between users.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the app. Change if 3000 is already in use.

Config.Name: Cookie Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED — Random secret (32+ characters) that signs the login cookie, so nobody can forge a login. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it private and stable: the app refuses to start if it is shorter than 32 characters, and changing it logs everyone out.

Config.Name: Database folder
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database is stored. Keep this in appdata for safety.

Config.Name: PDF Storage folder
Config.Description: Where uploaded PDF bank statements are stored. Can point at an SMB share (e.g. /mnt/user/PersonalFinanceApp).

Config.Name: Backup folder
Config.Description: Where database backups (finance_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.db) are written. Best on another disk than the database folder, e.g. a share on the array such as /mnt/user/backups/PersonalFinanceApp. To restore: stop the container, replace finance.db in the Database folder with a backup (delete finance.db-wal / finance.db-shm if present), start it.

Config.Name: BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Internal path for backups. Must match the container side of the Backup folder volume above.

Config.Name: Backups to keep (BACKUP_KEEP)
Config.Description: Number of most recent backups kept; older ones are deleted automatically. With daily backups, 14 is two weeks (restarts add extra backups).

Config.Name: Backup interval in hours (BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS)
Config.Description: Hours between automatic backups while the container runs. 0 = only at container start.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: SQLite connection string. Only change if you moved the data folder to a non-default path inside the container.

Config.Name: STORAGE_PATH
Config.Description: Internal path for PDF storage. Must match the container side of the PDF Storage volume above.

Config.Name: SERVER_HOST
Config.Description: Interface the app binds to. 0.0.0.0 means all interfaces (required for Docker port mapping).

Config.Name: SERVER_PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Must match the container side of Web UI Port above.

Config.Name: Log verbosity (RUST_LOG)
Config.Description: Tracing filter. Use =debug for verbose output, =warn for quiet. Example: personal_finance_app=debug,tower_http=info
